sha.note: Social Health Insurance Fund contribution remitted to the Social Health Authority. It replaces NHIF and is not an income-banded NHIF deduction.

nssf.note: NSSF contribution rates and pensionable earnings limits are subject to the current NSSF Year 4 schedule. Confirm the applicable payroll month before filing.

housingLevy.note: Affordable Housing Levy is 1.5% of gross salary for the employee and employer. Confirm current deductibility treatment with KRA payroll guidance.
